disposition_reason: Reports annual mean, SD and range of mercury, cadmium and lead in muscle, liver and kidney of feeder pigs from three swine farms in Hodonín district, 1994-1999 (feed and barn dust also measured, not recorded as findings).

study.origin: three swine farms (D., M., T.) in Hodonín district, Czech Republic, an area with lignite mines, a power plant and heavy traffic
study.market: not purchased; tissues of slaughtered farm pigs
study.method: dry ashing with Mg(NO3)2 to 470 C, HNO3 dissolution, flame AAS (Perkin Elmer 3100) for Cd and Pb; AMA mercury analyser for Hg
study.qa: reproducibility Hg 1.5%, Cd and Pb < 10%; no CRM or recovery reported

Abstract says kidney lead exceeded the limit in 1996 (0.74) and 1999 (0.77 mg/kg); Table 3 puts the 0.770 max in 1997 and gives a 1999 max of 0.040.
Several lead means and minima are below the stated method sensitivity of 0.05 mg/kg (flagged).
Lead exceeded the muscle limit in 16 of 42 muscle samples (0.11-0.23 mg/kg) per the abstract; detection count only, not a finding.
Feed (n = 85) and barn dust (n = 44) results are not food findings. Fresh or dry basis is not stated.
Figures 1-15 compare with Czech national means; values are figure-only and not recorded.
